```{r data}
df_inni = read_csv("./data/taiwanese_bankruptcy_prediction.csv")
```

```{r bankruptcy_rate_plot}
target <- "Bankrupt?"   # 你的目標欄名
y <- df_inni[[target]]
X_names <- setdiff(names(df), target)

# Fig 1: class distribution
df_inni %>%
  count(.data[[target]]) %>%
  mutate(pct = n/sum(n)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(.data[[target]]), y = n)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(n, "\n(", scales::percent(pct, 0.01), ")")),
            vjust = -0.2) +
  labs(x="Bankrupt (0/1)", y="Count", title="Class distribution")
```
```{r plot_2}
target <- "Bankrupt?"  # 目標欄名（保持原樣，不用改）

# 你自己指定要畫的 4 個變數（把下面四個換成你資料裡的欄名）
vars <- c(
  "Net Income to Total Assets",
  "ROA(A) before interest and % after tax",
  "Debt ratio %",
  "Working Capital to Total Assets"
)

plot_density_overlay <- function(df_inni, target, v, fig_no){
  p <- df_inni %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = .data[[v]], fill = factor(.data[[target]]))) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.45, na.rm = TRUE) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Fig ", fig_no, ". Distribution: ", v),
      x = v,
      fill = "Bankrupt (0/1)"
    ) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
}

fig2 <- plot_density_overlay(df_inni, target, vars[1], 2)
fig3 <- plot_density_overlay(df_inni, target, vars[2], 3)
fig4 <- plot_density_overlay(df_inni, target, vars[3], 4)
fig5 <- plot_density_overlay(df_inni, target, vars[4], 5)

fig2; fig3; fig4; fig5

```
```{r plot6}
# 用你現在的 df_inni
df <- df_inni
target <- "Bankrupt?"

stopifnot(target %in% names(df))

y <- df[[target]]
if (!is.numeric(y)) y <- as.numeric(as.character(y))

# 只保留 numeric 特徵
X <- df %>%
  select(-all_of(target)) %>%
  select(where(is.numeric))

# 去掉全 NA、或零變異的欄
X <- X %>%
  select(where(~ sum(!is.na(.x)) > 2)) %>%
  select(where(~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0))

if (ncol(X) == 0) stop("X has 0 numeric columns after filtering (all non-numeric / all NA / zero variance).")
if (nrow(X) == 0) stop("X has 0 rows (df might have been filtered to empty).")

# 與 target 的相關（用 pairwise.complete.obs，比 complete.obs 更不容易全 NA）
corr_y <- map_dbl(names(X), function(v){
  suppressWarnings(cor(X[[v]], y, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
})

# 移除 NA correlations
corr_y <- corr_y[!is.na(corr_y)]
if (length(corr_y) < 2) stop("Too few usable features: correlations are mostly NA.")

k <- min(25, length(corr_y))
top_vars <- names(sort(abs(corr_y), decreasing = TRUE))[1:k]

# 相關矩陣（這裡不會空）
corr_mat <- cor(X %>% select(all_of(top_vars)), use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

corr_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(corr_mat)) %>%
  rename(var1 = Var1, var2 = Var2, corr = Freq)

fig6 <- ggplot(corr_df, aes(x = var1, y = var2, fill = corr)) +
  geom_tile() +
  labs(
    title = "Fig 6. Correlation heatmap (Top features by |corr with target|)",
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 7),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7)
  )

ggsave("Fig6_corr_heatmap_top25.png", fig6, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 200)
fig6

head()
```
